title: Abolition Feminist Thought and Action
description: Investigates the proliferation of carceral logics in contemporary society, building on anti-capitalist, queer, dis/ability, Marxist, Black and Indigenous feminist politics and thought. Explores the contemporary intersection of feminist visions of a liberatory world that is made possible by putting thought into action. Draws on archival materials, film, podcasts, music, creative writing, memoir and feminist political theories.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of GNDR 338, GNDR 480 (if taken in the same topic).
